algorithm: {The proposed algorithm is a hybrid of Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Simulated Annealing (SA), which combines the exploration-exploitation trade-off of PSO with the adaptability of SA to escape local optima and avoid premature convergence.}

{ This new algorithm is an adaptive random search with a probabilistic hill-climbing step, tailored to minimize the given 5-dimensional Rosenbrock function within the specified bounds and computational budget. }
